sourcePolicy: These additions are separate from the source figure inventory and reproduction count. The supplied PDF and rendered source pages remain private local inputs.
sourceBook: Michael C. Gemignani, Elementary Topology, Second Edition

verification.nativeOptimization: Both static factories converge in five optimization steps; canonical and sampled interactive builds also converge and render valid XML SVG.
verification.canonicalInteraction: jitter=0 retains all initial label-layout offsets within 1e-8 of zero.
verification.sourceDisplay: One-based Substance declaration ranges are derived from the TypeScript AST. The coordinate-slice inspector exposes the existing realLineEmbeddingSubstance declaration and its actual arguments.

illustrations.sourceInspection: Read the page image and the available transcription: Y is the x-axis, A=Y, A has empty interior and frontier A in R squared; in Y its interior is Y and its frontier is empty.
mathematics: The ambient and induced subspace topologies are distinct entities.
InteriorOf, FrontierOf and ClosureOf are asserted separately for each topology.
The off-line witness q lies strictly inside the disk neighborhood of p.
The relative neighborhood is a finite intersection of that disk with Y.
The interval endpoints are drawn as excluded; the disk boundary is dashed.
illustrations.reuse: One subspaceDerivedSetsStyle instance renders two distinct horizontal affine lines and neighborhood radii. It reuses existing topology drawing helpers and coarse point-set vocabulary.
illustrations.visualReview: Viewed the native SVG rendered onto white: paired panels align, pale orange indicates the same set in both spaces, the off-line witness is visible, and the six derived-set formulas remain legible.

illustrations.sourceInspection: Read PDF page 87 and the available proof transcription: fixing the other coordinates embeds a factor into the product; projection onto the varying coordinate is inverse to the corestriction onto the image.
mathematics: The default coordinate inclusion is q_2(x)=(0.75,x).
Its image is the vertical slice {0.75} times R, with its induced subspace topology.
The corestriction is a homeomorphism onto that image; the second projection is its inverse.
The mapped point is geometrically on the correct constant-coordinate line.
illustrations.reuse: Uses the existing realLineEmbeddingSubstance and coordinateEmbeddingStyle from Figure 4.10. The same style instance renders both a vertical nonzero slice and a horizontal nonzero slice; showAmbientAxes is an optional view that preserves the source figure's default composition.
illustrations.visualReview: Viewed the native SVG rendered onto white: the orange image slice is separate from the dashed ambient axis, the fixed coordinate is labeled, the mapped point is connected to the axis by a dashed guide, and labels are clear of the slice.

limitations: The new affine-subspace comparison style currently renders horizontal affine lines; other affine orientations require an additional reusable view.
Live annotation dragging changes layout while the mathematical construction stays fixed.
Final website control behavior is reviewed separately in the local browser preview.
